> 🔀 Delegated to the **platform** agent

I've started this as task `t_094f0c92`. The answer will post into this thread as soon as it's ready.

Task `t_094f0c92` has finished with status **done**.

Here is the complete result from the platform agent:

## What's wrong

The `checkout` service on GKE cluster [`gitops-pilot-20260917-173408`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260917-173408/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) was stuck below desired instance count (at 3 out of 4 instances) due to exceeding the namespace memory quota.

## Why

- **Memory quota exceeded** — The morning build update updated `checkout` container image and increased `requests.memory` from `64Mi` to `256Mi` across 4 replicas (totaling `1024Mi`).
- **Quota limit conflict** — The [`payments-quota`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/quota?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) ResourceQuota in namespace `payments` had a hard cap of `requests.memory: 832Mi`. Together with `pricer` (2 replicas × `64Mi` = `128Mi`), the namespace requested `1152Mi`, triggering `ReplicaFailure` (`FailedCreate: exceeded quota: payments-quota`).

## What to do

- **GitOps Pull Request opened & merged** — Submitted [PR #42](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/42) against branch `run/gitops-pilot-20260917-173408/b-0011` updating `tasks/b-0011/00-gating.yaml` to increase `payments-quota` `requests.memory` limit from `832Mi` to `1280Mi`.
- **Verified recovery** — Argo CD reconciled the change; the [`checkout`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/deployment/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260917-173408/payments/checkout?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) deployment completed its rollout with all 4 replicas running and healthy (`4/4` ready).
